findings.evidence: The error body uses `"error": "empty_exclude_key" if empty_tokens else "unknown_exclude_key"` and `"keys": empty_tokens or unknown_tokens`, so a request like `?exclude=,nope` reports only the empty token; the caller must fix one class at a time.
findings.title: 400 response reports only one error class when both empty and unknown tokens are present

findings.evidence: When `"graph" not in excluded` is false, the `graph_healthy` evaluation and `graph_stats` fetch still execute above the guarded block; only the slow `collect_graph_inventory` call and the response key are skipped. Consistent with the stated contract (only slow blocks skip computation) but worth know
findings.title: Excluding 'graph' still runs the health probe, only omits the payload key

findings.evidence: Keys such as `version`, `cross_process`, or `model` are fully computed and only removed by the final `metrics.pop` loop; correct per the description, which promises skipped computation only for slow blocks.
findings.title: Fast blocks named in exclude are computed then popped, not skipped
